run.original_sample_description: Cross-sectional study of intestinal flora in Parkinson's patients in central China
run.Original_Project_description: Intestinal microbiome disorderplays play an important role in the occurrence and development of Parkinson's disease, and the purpose of this study is to accurately, comprehensively and in detail assess the composition of the intestinal microbiome in patients with Parkinson's disease in central China.
